part.text:
All 1175 browser tests pass (11 skipped by design), and the TS lint errors match the pre-existing baseline exactly.

## Summary of changes

**`src/diff/index.js` — `applyRef`** (src/diff/index.js:816): When a function ref is invoked with a non-null value and returns a function, that function is stored as `ref._cleanup`. When the ref is later reset to `null` (on unmount or when the ref changes), the cleanup function is invoked instead of calling the ref with `null` — matching React 19 semantics. Function refs without a cleanup keep the old `ref(null)` behavior, and object refs are untouched.

**`src/index.d.ts`**: `RefCallback` now returns `void | (() => void)`.

**`src/internal.d.ts`**: Internal `RefCallback` type updated with the new return type and the internal `_cleanup` slot.

This covers both new test cases: cleanup on unmount (ref never called with `null` when it returns a cleanup) and cleanup invoked whenever the callback ref function changes between renders.
